raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Advance matching `.main.commit` and `3rdparty/Megatron-LM` pins from `a8a5977f7611e9a8aac205eabd2f9b43f786bc8f` to `e0c5e18673bf4d4fd89cf87c4f1afbe521fe297f` ([upstream comparison](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/compare/a8a5977f7611e9a8aac205eabd2f9b43f786bc8f...e0c5e18673bf4d4fd89cf87c4f1afbe521fe297f)).

The range includes DSA indexer projection precision controls (#6842), upstream test annotations (#8120), and Testmon cache compatibility (#8001). No Bridge compatibility or dependency changes are needed from inspection; `uv.lock` and `.dev.commit` remain unchanged. Only the two matching pins change.

Local validation passed in the Linux/CUDA container: `uv lock`, `uv lock --check` (345 packages; no lockfile delta), all-file pre-commit, `git diff --check`, pin/gitlink equality, and byte-for-byte dev-pin preservation.

Full L0/L1/L2 CI is requested, carrying forward the unfinished October 11 midnight request. Both tier labels are applied. On head `d34952e37ae06e87c15a576fbeee58d322f6d740`, [CICD NeMo run 38166362241](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/38166362241), attempt 1, passed. Configure outputs confirm both full labels and L1/L2 selection. All 119 functional jobs passed: H100 L0/L1/L2 = 30/26/17; GB200 L0/L1/L2 = 12/21/13. Unit tests and the CICD aggregate also passed.

As of October 11, 16:55 America/Los_Angeles, build/release (38166362548, attempt 1) and installation (38166362203, attempt 1) remain queued. The remaining completed non-review workflows passed. Merge is pending those standard gates; full validation is not yet complete.

Automatic Claude reviews have been retired. To request a pull-request review, post a comment containing:

```
/review
```

Add `model=claude` to use a Claude reviewer (the default is `model=codex`). `mode=light|strict` selects the review depth; for example, `/review model=claude mode=strict`. Comment `/review help` for all options.
